The Tenno Sho (Autumn). Ahead of the 
rematch between Air Groove and Silence 
Suzuka, the venue was wrapped in an 
extraordinary fervor.

Having regained her resolve, Air Groove 
quietly exchanged words with Silence 
Suzuka, who had eagerly awaited a showdown 
with her.

And the "Empress," as a "challenger" 
leading all Umamusume, and as her 
Trainer's "ideal"... took on the challenge 
of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
